About Lantern Dao

A hidden valley that folds the Classic of Mountains and Seas into one island. Every building, tree and creature was modelled headlessly in Blender from primitives and shipped as one 2 MB kit; the world, the crowds and the light are assembled at runtime in three.js.

Mountains and seas. A mountain in each quarter: Kunlun to the north-west (langgan trees, the Weak Water, nine gates watched by the Kaiming beast), Fajiu to the north-east (zhe trees, Jingwei carrying stones), Tanggu to the south-east (the Fusang tree and its ten suns), Zhaoyao to the south-west (cassia, migu, the phoenix of Danxue). Every demon, elite and Xingtian himself has a chapter; and whatever the book says happens when it is seen happens here: Mingshe brings drought, Bifang strange fire, Fei the plague, Dangkang a harvest, Fenghuang peace.

The loop. Beasts pour in from the mist. Cut them down, gather the langgan jade they drop, and choose a technique at every breakthrough. Cinnabar grains buy permanent refinements at the forge in the Qingyao market. At seven and a half minutes Zhulong closes its eyes; at eight Xingtian comes, dancing with shield and axe. Keep the lamp for ten minutes and the endless road opens.

Lantern Dao · Shanhai is the re-skin of Emberlight, itself inspired by 歸藏's GPT-6 Astra + Blender + Godot original. Quotations are from the received text of the Shanhaijing; later commentaries and derived images are not used.
